alone_net_ms.description: HEADLINE: all tap operations of a call run alone, one clock, net of the stand-in block call

alone_raw_ms.description: same interval before subtracting the baseline loop (includes the stand-in block call)

begin_ms.description: begin_call (per-call reset; no allocation after the first call of the run)

hook_cpu_net_ms.description: hook calls without growth: CPU time (Python bookkeeping, indexing, launch), net of the stand-in call

growth_cpu_net_ms.description: hook calls that grow the buffer: CPU time (allocation, zeros and copy launches)

growth_wait_net_ms.description: wait for the growth zeros / old-buffer copy on the device

drain_ms.description: device work left over by the hook calls after the CPU finished enqueueing

end_call_ms.description: end_call: whole call-end scoring path (scoring, pooling, read-back, decision, bookkeeping)

score_head_ms.description: of which _score_head (the live score_s): scoring, pooling and read-back

split_scoring_ms.description: replica split: normalise, dot, bias (enqueue + execution)

split_pooling_ms.description: replica split: sum, mean, roll-up, stack

split_readback_ms.description: replica split: read-back to the host

partition_total_ms.description: sum of the consecutive CPU-clock intervals of pass B

gpu_capture_raw_ms.description: device time of the hook calls (events, raw), no-growth hooks

gpu_growth_span_ms.description: event span of the growth hook calls (includes allocator CPU time)

kernel_step_ms.description: device kernel time of the per-step capture copy (CUPTI profiler)

kernel_growth_ms.description: device kernel time of the buffer growth (zeros, old-buffer copy; CUPTI)

kernel_total_ms.description: device kernel time of begin_call and all hook calls (CUPTI)

device_bound_total_ms.description: COMPANION (device view, upper): begin + event span of capture (floor-corrected) + growth + end_call (hook CPU time not added)

device_kernel_total_ms.description: COMPANION (device view, lower): begin + kernel time of the per-step copy (CUPTI) + growth + end_call (hook CPU time not added)
